title: valueerror while exporting the monthly report (summary.total)
body:
Environment

Lattice version 3.1.2; operating system Windows Server 2022;
server region us-east-1.

Steps

How to trigger it:
* With the log window open, start exporting the monthly
  report.
* Use a figure such as 0.12345678.
* Check the journal pane; the stack trace appears there.

Expected

No stack trace; exporting the monthly report normally takes a
few seconds.

Actual

It fails on a decimal figure with many digits after the
point. The decimal values that fail all have seven or more
fractional digits.

Frequency

Reproduces roughly one run in three.
stacktrace:
lattice/ui/main.py:49 in loop
lattice/report/schedule.py:67 in run_due
lattice/report/builder.py:137 in build
lattice/report/summary.py:103 in total
ValueError: cannot convert float NaN to integer
